title: Longest Subarray Divisible by K with At Most One Negation II
statement: The task asks for the longest subarray of an array of up to 10^5 integers whose sum is divisible by k ≤ 3000, either as-is or after negating one element. Negating x shifts the sum by -2x, so validity depends only on the prefix-sum residues at the ends; using each residue's first and last occurrence leaves k² residue pairs, each checked in O(1).
